name: Hristiyana Stankova
bio: Hristiyana is a final-year MChem Medicinal Chemistry student at the University of St Andrews. During the past two summers, she completed internships within AstraZeneca’s clinical supply chain. She also conducted research in the Maus Laboratory at Harvard Medical School, focusing on a T-cell-centric approach to treating autoimmune diseases.
education: University of St Andrews (MChem Chemistry with Medicinal Chemistry, 2022–27)
